$comment: Where the vendored catalog.json came from, and — when it leads the published engine — why that is allowed. `sync-catalog.mjs --check` enforces every claim in this file, in both directions: an unexplained difference fails, and so does an `aheadOfPublished` marker that the publish has since caught up with.
why: IN SYNC as of @paged-media/introspect-wasm@0.65.0 (2026-10-04): the vendored copy, the published package and core@ffb7c87 (tag v0.65.0) crates/paged-introspect/catalog.json are byte-identical, verified by `sync-catalog.mjs --check` against a scratch install of that exact version. Protocol 65 adds the paragraphComposer path, the style-properties read and duplicateElements. History: during the capability-parity campaign the copy led the publish by one protocol (re-synced from core because the 0.62.0 published catalog had drifted badly: 30 host functions against 144, 176 settable paths against 202, four phantom layer* paths, no `operations` key); v0.63.0 closed that gap. The record stays because the NEXT protocol bump may open a lead again, and the shape of the allowance is the thing worth keeping.
